svg.title: Observed low-dose delivery boundary under BF16 execution

cc:Work.dc:title: Observed low-dose delivery boundary under BF16 execution
cc:Work.dc:description: Three aligned plots show the low-dose delivery transition under BF16 execution in this model and intervention setup, across requested doses from 0.5% to 30%. Directional cosine rises sharply from a median 0.961 at 0.5% toward 1.0 and clears its 0.995 threshold by the eligible panel. Relative RMSE falls from a median 0.287 at 0.5% through its 0.10 ceiling near 1.5–2% and continues toward zero. Pale bands show the minimum-to-maximum range across the fixed 24-cell census, not uncertainty. The bottom strip reports the full paired-branch delivery rule: 24 failed cells at 0.5%, 24 at 1%, 18 at 1.5%, and zero from 2% through 30%.
